title: HardcoreSMP
description: Vanilla Hardcore Minecraft server. Once you die, you will never be able to play again
body:

[![Discord Icon](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy-minimal/social/discord-singular_vector.svg)](https://discord.gg/z6hgyKthBN)

HardcoreSMP is a Hardcore Minecraft server. Once you die, you will never be able to play again.

IP : `38.143.19.130`


[Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat) is installed on this server.

![Spawn image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Gy6KRoBv/images/606554c85bb17337996239344b76f727b5ef85e1.png)

This server is created to have a Hardcore, Vanilla Minecraft Server with a community gathered.

You can also chat, participate in votes, and read announcements on the Discord !
